title: Arbiter Livelock on Simultaneous Grant Revoke
description: When two masters simultaneously drop their requests at the same cycle the grant was updated, the arbiter pointer skips both and enters a livelock loop.
bug_signature: UVM_FATAL: [LIVELOCK] Grant pointer cycles without any transaction completing
expected_root_cause: The grant pointer update and request de-assertion happen in the same cycle; the combinational path skips both deasserted requests, cycling indefinitely [4, 17].
testbench: task run(); fork m0.assert_req(); m1.assert_req(); #20; m0.deassert(); m1.deassert(); join endtask
failure_log: T=100: REQ0=0, REQ1=0. GNT_PTR cycling. No transaction. Timeout.
success_log: Arbiter returns to IDLE with no transaction when all requests drop simultaneously.
fix_replacement: always_ff @(posedge clk) if (any_req) gnt_ptr <= next_ptr_with_req; else gnt_ptr <= gnt_ptr;
